stem.text: Hydroxyethanal, $\text{HOCH}_2\text{CHO}$, is heated under reflux with an excess of acidified $\text{K}_2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7$ until no further oxidation takes place.
What is the skeletal formula of the organic product?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: HO–C(=O)–CH2–C(=O)–OH, a dicarboxylic acid with a CH2 between the two carboxyl groups.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: HO–C(=O)–C(=O)–OH, a dicarboxylic acid with the two carboxyl carbons joined directly.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: HO–CH2–C(=O)–OH, a hydroxy carboxylic acid with a CH2 between the OH and the carboxyl group.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: an aldehyde C=O joined directly to a carboxyl group (C=O and OH), i.e. OHC–COOH.
